nodes.description: Constant address of the Connectors registry used to verify chief permissions.
Constant address of the InstaIndex contract whose master is checked for authorization.
Public version number of the helper contract, initialized to 1.
Public mapping from underlying ERC20 address to its cToken (CrToken) address.
Internal function that validates and registers a cToken mapping for its underlying token.
External chief-only function that batch-registers cToken mappings for an array of cTokens.
Constructor of InstaCreamMapping, registers the ETH pseudo-address mapping and the provided cTokens.
Caller address used in the isChief authorization check.
Address parameter crTkn of _addCrtknMapping, the cToken to register.
Array of cToken addresses passed to addCrtknMapping.
Local copy of the cToken address inside _addCrtknMapping.
Underlying ERC20 address returned by the cToken's underlying() call.
Loop index used in addCrtknMapping over the crTkns array.
Array of cToken addresses passed to the InstaCreamMapping constructor.
Loop index used in the constructor over the crTkns array.
Local constant representing the ETH pseudo-address 0xEeee...EEeE.
Local constant holding the crETH cToken address mapped to the ETH pseudo-address.
isChief authorization require: Connectors.chief(msg.sender) or InstaIndex.master() == msg.sender.
Require that crTokenMapping[erc20] is still address(0), preventing duplicate token registration.
Require that the input crTkns array is not empty in addCrtknMapping.
External call to CrTokenInterface(cErc20).underlying() on an arbitrary caller-supplied cToken address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by the isChief authority check.
The connectors registry address is used to resolve the caller's chief status.
The instaIndex address is used to query master() for the authorization decision.
The isChief modifier gates the execution of addCrtknMapping.
The isChief-gated path reaches the internal _addCrtknMapping via addCrtknMapping.
The crTkn parameter is copied into the local cErc20 variable.
The caller-supplied cToken address is used as the target of the underlying() external call.
The return value of underlying() is stored into the local erc20 variable.
The derived underlying token address is used as the key in the duplicate-registration check.
The duplicate check reads the crTokenMapping state mapping.
The cToken address is written into crTokenMapping[erc20].
_addCrtknMapping mutates the crTokenMapping state mapping.
addCrtknMapping loops and calls the internal _addCrtknMapping.
The crTkns array determines the bounds of the loop counter i.
The crTkns array length is validated by the non-empty require.
The array-length require guards further execution of addCrtknMapping.
Each loop iteration invokes _addCrtknMapping for the indexed cToken.
Elements of crTkns are passed as the crTkn argument to _addCrtknMapping.
The constructor invokes _addCrtknMapping for each provided cToken.
The constructor crTkns array determines the bounds of its loop counter i.
Constructor loop iterations call _addCrtknMapping.
Constructor array elements are forwarded to _addCrtknMapping.
The ETH pseudo-address is used as a key in crTokenMapping.
The crETH address is written as the value of crTokenMapping[ethAddress].

normalization_plan.reason: crTkn is an argument of _addCrtknMapping and is fully consumed within that function.
crTkns is the argument array iterated over inside addCrtknMapping.
cErc20 is a temporary alias of crTkn inside _addCrtknMapping.
erc20 is derived and used only inside _addCrtknMapping to index crTokenMapping.
The loop index i only controls the loop inside addCrtknMapping.
crTkns is the constructor argument array iterated during deployment setup.
The constructor loop index i only controls the constructor's mapping loop.
ethAddress is a constructor-local constant used to seed crTokenMapping.
crEth is a constructor-local constant assigned into crTokenMapping.
